content: Need MM/DD/YYYY, separator "/" optional (but presumably consistent — simplest: optional slash each place). Months with 31 days: 01,03,05,07,08,10,12 → days 01-31 Months with 30 days: 04,06,09,11 → days 01-30 February: 01-29 ``` ^(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])/?(?:0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)/?(?:0[1-9]|[12]\d|30)|02/?(?:0[1-9]|[12]\d))/?\d{4}$ ```

We need MM/DD/YYYY with optional "/" separator. MM two digits zero padded, DD two digits zero padded, YYYY four digits.

Months: 01,03,05,07,08,10,12 → 31 days; 04,06,09,11 → 30 days; 02 → 29 days.

Pattern:

^(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])/?(?:0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)/?(?:0[1-9]|[12]\d|30)|02/?(?:0[1-9]|1\d|2[0-9]))/?\d{4}$

Wait 02: 01-29 → (?:0[1-9]|[12]\d) gives 01-29. Good.
